questions.question: If sec θ + tan θ = 5, then find the value of tan θ.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sec θ + tan θ = 5

**Concept used:**

If sec θ + tan θ = y

then sec θ - tan θ = 1/y

**Calculation:**

sec θ + tan θ = 5 ----- (1)

then,

sec θ - tan θ = 1/5 ------- (2)

Subtracting the eq. (1) and (2)

⇒ (sec θ + tan θ) - (sec θ - tan θ) = (5 - 1/5)

⇒ sec θ + tan θ - sec θ + tan θ = 24/5

⇒ 2 × tan θ = 24/5

⇒ tan θ = 12/5

**∴ The correct answer is 12/5.**

A policeman follows a thief who is 600 m ahead of the policeman. If the policeman and the thief run at speeds of 10 km/h and 8 km/h, respectively, in how much time (in minutes), will the policeman catch the thief?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between policeman and thief = 600 m

Speed of policeman = 10 km/h

Speed of thief = 8 km/h

**Formula used:**

Distance = relative speed × time

**Calculation:**

Distance = relative speed × time

⇒ 600 = (10 - 8) × (5/18) × time

⇒ Time = (600 × 18)/(2 × 5)

⇒ Time = (60 × 18) = 1080 sec

⇒ Time = 1080 sec. = 1080/60 = 18 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 18 minutes.**

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 36?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a number to be divisible by 36, it must be divisible by its co-prime factors, 4 and 9.

Rule for 4: Last two digits must be divisible by 4 → 47502 is eliminated (02 is not divisible by 4).

Rule for 9: Sum of digits must be a multiple of 9.

Checking remaining options: Sum of digits for 29412 = 2 + 9 + 4 + 1 + 2 = 18 (Divisible by 9).

**∴ The correct answer is 29412.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers to check: 47502, 29412, 54732, 87064

**Concept Used:**

Since 36 = 4 × 9 and gcd(4, 9) = 1, any number divisible by 36 must be divisible by both 4 and 9.

Divisibility by 4: The number formed by the last two digits is divisible by 4.

Divisibility by 9: The sum of the digits of the number is divisible by 9.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Step 1: Check divisibility by 4 (Last two digits)

⇒ 47502 → 02 is not divisible by 4.

⇒ 29412 → 12 is divisible by 4.

⇒ 54732 → 32 is divisible by 4.

⇒ 87064 → 64 is divisible by 4.

⇒ Step 2: Check divisibility by 9 for the remaining numbers (Sum of digits)

⇒ 29412 → 2 + 9 + 4 + 1 + 2 = 18 (18 is divisible by 9)

⇒ 54732 → 5 + 4 + 7 + 3 + 2 = 21 (21 is not divisible by 9)

⇒ 87064 → 8 + 7 + 0 + 6 + 4 = 25 (25 is not divisible by 9)

⇒ Hence, only 29412 satisfies both conditions.

**∴ The correct answer is 29412.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by Composite Numbers

If a number is divisible by a composite number, it must be completely divisible by all of its co-prime factors (e.g., for 72, check 8 and 9).

Divisibility Rule of 8

A number is divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last three digits is divisible by 8.

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of its digits at odd places and the sum of its digits at even places is either 0 or a multiple of 11.
</p

questions.question: To go a distance of 144 km upstream, a rower takes 12 hours while it takes her only 9 hours to row the same distance downstream. What is the speed of the stream?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Downstream speed = 144 ÷ 9 = 16 km/h

Upstream speed = 144 ÷ 12 = 12 km/h

Speed of stream = (Downstream speed − Upstream speed) ÷ 2

Speed of stream = (16 − 12) ÷ 2 = 2 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 2 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance (D) = 144 km

Time taken upstream (Tᵤ) = 12 hours

Time taken downstream (Td) = 9 hours

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Speed of stream (Sₛ) = (Speed downstream − Speed upstream) ÷ 2

 
 Distance = 144 km
 
 

 

 Downstream: 9 hours (16 km/h)
 
 

 

 Upstream: 12 hours (12 km/h)

 Speed of stream = (16 − 12) ÷ 2 = 2 km/h

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed downstream (Sd) = 144 ÷ 9 = 16 km/h

⇒ Speed upstream (Sᵤ) = 144 ÷ 12 = 12 km/h

⇒ Speed of stream = (Sd − Sᵤ) ÷ 2

⇒ Speed of stream = (16 − 12) ÷ 2

⇒ Speed of stream = 4 ÷ 2

⇒ Speed of stream = 2 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 2 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed of Boat in Still Water

It is calculated as half the sum of downstream and upstream speeds: Sb = (Sd + Sᵤ) ÷ 2

Downstream Speed

When the boat moves in the same direction as the flow of the river, speeds are added: Sd = Sb + Sₛ

Upstream Speed

When the boat moves against the flow of the river, speeds are subtracted: Sᵤ = Sb − Sₛ

Average Speed for Round Trip

If a boat goes a certain distance and returns, the average speed = (2 × Sᵤ × Sd) ÷ (Sᵤ + Sd)

questions.question: The perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 48 cm. Find its area (in cm²).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter of an equilateral triangle = 48 cm

**Formula used:**

The perimeter of equilateral triangle = 3 × side

**Calculation:**

The perimeter of an equilateral triangle = 48

⇒ 3 × side = 48

⇒ Side = 48/3 = 16 cm

Area of an equilateral triangle = {√3 × (side)²}/4

⇒ {√3 × (16)2}/4 = 256√3/4 

⇒ 64√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 64√3 cm2.**
